title: Eventual equality of raw abelian section representatives
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories, and $V$ a cocone whose object and arrow cocones are set colimits [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Fix $i\in J$ and put $I=(i\downarrow J)$; for $t\in I$ write $v_t=V_{t.right}$ and $f_t=F(t.hom)$. Equip each $F(j)$ with a precoverage $P_j$, with every transition functor continuous for the generated Grothendieck topologies [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Fix an abelian sheaf $G$ on $F(i)$ and $U\in F(i)$, and put $A_t=f_{t,s}G$ and $U_t=f_t(U)$. Give sheaf maps $\theta_b:A_t\to F(b.right)^sA_{t'}$ for all $b:t\to t'$. Give a diagram $B:I\to\mathrm{PSh}(V.pt,\mathrm{Ab})$ and left Kan units $\beta_t:A_t\to v_t^pB_t$ (composition with $\beta_t$ bijects maps $B_t\to T$ with maps $A_t\to v_t^pT$ for every abelian presheaf $T$). Assume $\operatorname{Arrow.mk}(\beta_t(X)B(b)(v_tX))=\operatorname{Arrow.mk}(\theta_b(X)\beta_{t'}(F(b.right)X))$ for each stage object $X$. Give a diagram $D:I\to\mathrm{Ab}$ with isomorphisms $E_t:D_t\cong A_t(U_t)$. Set $Y=V_i(U)$ and $H=\operatorname{colim}B$. Suppose $\kappa_t:D_t\to H(Y)$ satisfies: there is an equality $e_t:v_t(U_t)=Y$ such that $\kappa_t$ is $E_t$, then $\beta_t(U_t)$, then the coprojection $B_t\to H$ at $v_t(U_t)$, then transport along $e_t$. Assume $\operatorname{Arrow.mk}(E_t\theta_b(U_t))=\operatorname{Arrow.mk}(D(b)E_{t'})$ for every $b:t\to t'$. If $x\in D_t$ and $x'\in D_{t'}$ have $\kappa_t(x)=\kappa_{t'}(x')$, there are $r\in I$, $b:t\to r$, and $b':t'\to r$ with $D(b)(x)=D(b')(x')$.

proof.text: Normalize E_t followed by beta_t to the fixed object Y using the endpoint equalities in hkappa. Arrow equality hm and hbeta_map, with naturality across the transports, prove these maps commute with D and B. Naturality of the colimit coprojections identifies kappa with each normalized map followed by that coprojection.

Evaluate colimit B at Y and forget to sets, which preserves this filtered colimit. Its eventual equality criterion puts the two normalized representatives at a common stage k. Cancel the endpoint transport to get equality of beta_k unit images.

Apply abelian Kan unit relations to the stage presheaves and theta maps out of k, obtaining a refinement c:k to r where the transported sections agree. Use hm and injectivity of E_r and the endpoint transport to identify their D images. Functoriality gives the required composite arrows from t and t'.

theorem raw_abelian_section_relations
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (i : J) (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (θ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
                        (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                          (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
                        ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                          (P t.right).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj
                          ((sheafPullback (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                            (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (B : Under i ⥤ (V.ptᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}))
    (β : ∀ t : Under i,
      ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
        (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj ⟶
        (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.op ⋙ B.obj t)
    (hβ : ∀ t : Under i, (B.obj t).IsLeftKanExtension (β t))
    (hβmap : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t') (X : F.obj t.right),
      Arrow.mk ((β t).app (op X) ≫
        (B.map b).app (op ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj X))) =
      Arrow.mk ((θ t t' b).hom.app (op X) ≫
        (β t').app (op ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.obj X))))
    (U : F.obj i)
    (D : Under i ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (E : ∀ t : Under i, D.obj t ≅ ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
        (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj.obj
          (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U)))
    (hm : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
      Arrow.mk ((E t).hom ≫
        (θ t t' b).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U))) =
      Arrow.mk (D.map b ≫ (E t').hom))
    (κ : ∀ t : Under i,
      D.obj t ⟶ (colimit B).obj (op ((V.ι.app i).toFunctor.obj U)))
    (hκ : ∀ t : Under i,
        ∃ e : (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U) =
            (V.ι.app i).toFunctor.obj U,
          κ t =
            (E t).hom ≫ (β t).app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U)) ≫
              (colimit.ι B t).app
                (op ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U))) ≫
              eqToHom (congrArg (fun X => (colimit B).obj (op X)) e)) :
    ∀ (t t' : Under i) (x : D.obj t) (x' : D.obj t'),
      κ t x = κ t' x' →
        ∃ (r : Under i) (b : t ⟶ r) (b' : t' ⟶ r), D.map b x = D.map b' x'
